breaking_news.headline: Red, white and glowing blue: Trump's push for new reactors reaches the finish line
breaking_news.summary: A program initiated by the Trump administration has allowed small companies to rush their testing of several new nuclear reactor designs. Some worry that safety is being compromised.

breaking_news.headline: Supreme Court cements Trump's power over agencies long considered independent
breaking_news.summary: In a 6-3 decision, the Supreme Court struck down a 91-year-old precedent that has prevented presidents from removing members of independent agencies meant to be a check on his power.

breaking_news.headline: Computer scientist on why he believes mass layoffs due to AI is a 'convenient excuse'
breaking_news.summary: NPR's Steve Inskeep asks Princeton computer scientist Sayash Kapoor about his assertions that AI won't lead to mass layoffs.

breaking_news.headline: How to eat out without spending a fortune
breaking_news.summary: Personal finance and nutrition experts share simple strategies that make it possible to eat out on a budget. One tip? You might have to let go of your fast food delivery habit.

breaking_news.headline: Meta considered buying Kalshi before developing its own prediction market app
breaking_news.summary: Mark Zuckerberg met with Kalshi's CEO last year about a potential deal, but talks did not move forward. Now Meta is making its own prediction market app.

breaking_news.headline: U.S. job market slows in June
breaking_news.summary: Employers added 57,000 jobs in June, the Labor Department said on Friday, as jobs growth slowed from the previous two months, while the unemployment rate ticked down to 4.2%.

breaking_news.headline: Trump earned more than $1 billion from crypto — but his investors didn't fare so well
breaking_news.summary: President Trump earned more than $1 billion in 2025 from cryptocurrency ventures. But there are thousands of investors who bought into some of those cryptocurrencies, and they stand to lose big.

breaking_news.headline: A hot summer trend in the sharing economy? Rental swimming pools
breaking_news.summary: Don't have a pool during this hot summer? Rent one! Swimply is a platform that lets users rent private pools.

breaking_news.headline: A mayor in Japan announced her maternity leave - and got the whole country talking
breaking_news.summary: In the face of criticism, Shoko Kawata, 35, says she loves her job and is proud to be taking time off to have a baby.

breaking_news.headline: Iran begins public mourning for Ayatollah killed in February
breaking_news.summary: Ali Khamenei's body will lie in state in Tehran's Grand Mosalla from Friday ahead of days-long funeral events.

breaking_news.headline: How the American Dream has survived 250 years, but only just
breaking_news.summary: The American Dream has persisted since the days of the Founding Fathers, but faith in the ideal is fading

breaking_news.headline: 'Most massive' Russian attack on Kyiv kills at least 30
breaking_news.summary: The latest barrage deployed the largest number of weapons on the capital and hit locations over a wide area.

breaking_news.headline: Taylor Swift's rumoured wedding celebrations begin with star-studded New York event
breaking_news.summary: Actress Lena Dunham, model Gigi Hadid and longtime music collaborator Jack Antonoff were spotted in formal attire near Madison Square Garden.

breaking_news.headline: Venezuela quake survivor pulled out alive after eight days
breaking_news.summary: Hernán Gil was trapped under a collapsed multi-storey car park.

breaking_news.headline: On the Strait of Hormuz, BBC finds seized ships and shark fishermen as uneasy calm returns
breaking_news.summary: The BBC travels to the city of Bandar Abbas - the first international journalists to visit the Iranian side of the strait.

breaking_news.headline: Ryanair warns of 'queue chaos' from new EU border system
breaking_news.summary: The airline calls on European governments to postpone the EES system until after the summer holiday period.

breaking_news.headline: Security staff to go on strike at Aberdeen Airport
breaking_news.summary: The strikes, involving baggage screening staff, are set to begin on Monday with the Unite union warning of "significant delays".

breaking_news.headline: AI is 'not smart' so what's next in artificial intelligence?
breaking_news.summary: Leading AI researcher Yan LeCun has a start-up which is developing a more flexible AI system.

breaking_news.headline: Instagram running ads promoting child sexual abuse material in India, BBC finds
breaking_news.summary: The ads use terms including “rape” and “child video” and link to content on the messaging app Telegram.

breaking_news.headline: Goat and skin in millions of 'lamb' kebabs compared to horsemeat lasagne scandal
breaking_news.summary: Millions are likely to have eaten "lamb" kebabs that were actually made with goat, skin and fat.
